name: Plant Biology PhD

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual date; if space remains, applications before December 31 considered.

english.note: Two-year scores; no TOEFL superscoring. US or qualifying English-official-country degree can exempt; foreign institution must confirm English instruction. Other waiver requests reviewed, not automatic. GTA funding requires TOEFL 100/5, IELTS 7 or DET 120.

applicationFee.note: Case-by-case hardship/qualifying-affiliation requests in application; no guarantee. Certain outside-fellowship international applicants explicitly mentioned; confirm eligibility. Allow 48 business hours.

requirements.note: Natural/physical-science major equivalent and prior research required. Faculty contact strongly recommended. First-year at least two lab rotations before committing; two supervised-teaching courses required.

funding.note: Program PhD students supported via research/teaching assistantships and tuition waiver up to nine graduate credits per semester. Central appointments open to international students. Central 2026–27 minima: $25,781/9 months or $34,375/12 months; confirm offer duration/rate.
